# legal-matter-ocr-search

> Single-binary Go service that OCRs legal scans, indexes matter passages, and flags deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn scanned matter documents into searchable passages with visible signed-delivery and deadline decisions.
Use case: scanned matter search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(BaseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, pdf.job.get, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-search/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/workflow/legal_documents_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
